english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the ancient philosophical school and its doctrines.

exampleSentences.english: The philosophy of stoicism says people should use reason to control their emotions.
exampleSentences.traditional: 斯多葛主義認為人應該用理性控制情緒。
